content.short: Espresso Sequencer provides a shared sequencer for credible neutrality, enhanced interoperability, and Ethereum alignment.
content.description: Espresso Sequencer is a decentralized sequencer and data availability system that connects layer-2 scaling solutions. By employing an optimistic responsiveness approach, it provides fast transaction finality and efficient throughput, with capacity limited primarily by network bandwidth rather than on-chain bottlenecks. The design coordinates sequencing and data availability to support the scaling of layer-2 solutions, reducing latency while preserving the security guarantees of decentralized operation.
